about_the_game:
The martial world runs on three simple rules: show respect, share a drink, and speak reason. This ancient escort guild wisdom reminds us that true strength comes not from the blade alone, but from knowing when to draw it. We may transport cargo, but we safeguard something far greater - peace itself.

Forge Your Legend from Ashes

Rise from the ruins of your destroyed escort agency with vengeance burning in your heart. Design and expand your headquarters - build training grounds, kitchens, forges, and alchemy labs to unlock powerful new abilities. Recruit extraordinary guards, each with unique skills and hidden martial arts secrets. Train them relentlessly, shaping raw talent into legendary warriors who can master devastating signature techniques. Every decision matters as you transform a broken dream into the realm's most feared and respected escort agency.

A Pixel Wuxia Masterpiece

Retro pixel art combines with traditional Chinese instrumentation to bring diverse landscapes to life - ancient towns, vast deserts, snowy wilderness, and tranquil waterways. Flutes, guqin, and drums create an authentic wuxia atmosphere that immerses you in this living martial world.

A World of Conspiracy and Wonder

Your escort missions become the stage for saga where honor clashes with betrayal, and every contract could change everything.

The main story follows survivors of a brutal massacre, driven by vengeance to uncover the truth. Through escort missions spanning the vast realm, you'll gather crucial intelligence while building your reputation and influence. Your investigation will expose a sinister conspiracy linking corrupt imperial agents with Japanese pirates - a plot that threatens the very foundation of the empire.

Beyond the main story, the road holds countless surprises. Cross paths with enigmatic merchants, wandering healers, desperate gamblers, and mystical fortune-tellers. Stumble upon local injustices, witness legendary duels, or help ordinary people in extraordinary circumstances... Every encounter writes a new chapter in your martial world saga.

Fast Strategic Combat

The game features streamlined yet tactical battles that maintain excitement without sacrificing depth. Every guard possesses unique skills, personality traits, growth paths, and martial disciplines. Form your ideal combat formation and master combination techniques to defeat the countless bandits who threaten your cargo.

Your Banner Your World

In Safeguard Saga, every mission could reshape history itself. From the ashes of tragedy to the ultimate showdown in the imperial capital, each journey may thrust you into events that determine the fate of nations. Will you plant your agency's flag across all corners of the realm while navigating deadly court intrigue and brutal martial world conflicts?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3-3220 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GT 730 or equivalent Intel/AMD dedicated or integrated graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-7600 or AMD R5-1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 or equivalent AMD dedicated graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 MB available space

short_description: Lead your own escort agency in a pixel-art wuxia world. Manage guards, take on perilous missions, and navigate a dynamic martial world filled with danger, betrayal, and honor.
